SECOND call evolvo_check_availability for the same doctor as the confirmed appointment (any branch unless the caller wants the same one), with date_from set to the period the caller asked for (for example a week later) or omitted if they gave none. THEN offer the new time and WAIT for the caller's answer - nothing is booked yet.
